outOfScope: Migrating, deleting or cutting over any current unfinished legacy Blackboard task.
Rewriting DONE task history or Living Docs.
constraints: Task 1 builds the new control plane only. It must not migrate or cut over any current unfinished legacy work.
Blackboard authority must be readable identically from any checkout/worktree and must not depend on whichever source branch is currently checked out.
A new Work must be creatable directly in the control plane before any source PR or branch exists.
Context is derived output, not authority: no context generation/history/currentContextRef persistence in the V2 model.
Source branches, worktrees and candidate SHAs are attempt bindings only and never become Blackboard truth.
Independent Jev judgment, exact candidate/evidence/merge binding, negative-case verification and Living Docs delivery truth remain trust primitives; V2 may adapt them but must not weaken them.
The lifecycle and legal next actions must be executable state-machine data/code; operator docs may explain semantics but cannot be required to infer what action is legal next.
invariants: Exactly one configured authority owns Work; reads from different checkouts are equivalent during a quiescent resourceVersion and never fall back to Git branch data.
Work.generation increments only on semantic spec changes; resourceVersion covers every status/spec mutation and stale decisions never apply.
Store-clock leases and persistent monotonic fences reject stale mutations; actor time cannot authorize takeover; read-only operations need no Attempt fence.
All lifecycle actions have executable guards, and pure nextActions/context consume only explicit immutable snapshot facts.
Actor-authored candidate/evidence records cannot alter spec, judge correctness or publish delivery; exact trusted Decision/receipt binding is required.
BB-155 creates only new synthetic V2 Work and leaves legacy current-work authority and all task records unchanged.
Contexts are derived values without stored identity/history; read-only phases grant zero product-source write authority.
architectureDecisions: D1 — One Node24+ service owns local-disk SQLite outside checkouts, ISOLATED_NEW_WORK mode; no legacy import, cutover or dual-write. Git CAS rejected because it lacks trusted lease clock.

D2 — SqliteBlackboardControlStore readSnapshot/createWork/apply/readRecord, WAL/FULL/foreign keys/5s busy timeout, BEGIN IMMEDIATE CAS of expected RV+generation with atomic Work and immutable records. Client cannot replace Work or write SQL.

D3 — Work.generation changes on semantic spec/plan revision; RV on every mutation. PUBLISH_PLAN rotates Research Attempt/fence/lease atomically into the new generation. Candidate/evidence are separate immutable version records; renewal appends immutable LeaseVersion, not edits to Attempt.

D4 — Server Date.now sampled inside transaction, durable lastCommittedTime rejects clock rollback including restart. now>=leaseUntil expires; durable fenceCounter never resets; all Attempt effects require current live identity/owner/fence.

D5 — Executable table in lifecycleContract defines all actions and guards; nextActions(snapshot) pure and canonical. Store repeats guards. Base failed candidate is BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED; BB-157 owns LOOKBACK extension.

D6 — buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) pure; resolved component/Living facts supplied explicitly. Only live exact implementation ownership in execution grants plan product scope. Research, judgment, merge and blocked scopes are phase-local; persist no Context.

D7 — Immutable Attempt binds Work generation/spec and source identity only. Status references immutable candidate/evidence/lease versions; actor fields cannot alter spec, ownership, readiness or correctness.

D8 — materializeWorkJudgment derives the delivered typed evaluator envelope from canonical Work and immutable source facts, with exact Work-generation/Attempt binding; existing evaluate/validateEvaluation remain judge authority. No legacy registration or rewritten verdict.
D9 — Independent exact accepted candidate Decision plus trusted candidate/main/merge/equal-tree/Living receipt is required for DELIVERED. Commands/producer text cannot deliver.

D10 — External absolute configuration pins one URL+authorityId; authenticated loopback HTTP with reader/actor/judge/operator capabilities, 1MiB/30s bounds; fail missing/wrong authority with no cwd fallback. package bin bb exposes create/show/next/context/serve/apply; import-safe createControlClient. New V2 Work needs no source PR.
implementationSlices: S1 — work-resource.mjs/control-store.mjs. Implement Work/spec/status and immutable Attempt, LeaseVersion, CandidateVersion, EvidenceVersion, Decision/Receipt schemas from resourceContract; status holds current refs, Attempt holds identity only. SQLite schema metadata/works/records with unique ids and persistent fenceCounter; every guarded operation BEGIN IMMEDIATE, schema/auth validation, store-clock regression check, RV/generation CAS, live lease/fence checks, record+status write and COMMIT, or full ROLLBACK. No raw Work replace. createWork inserts gen1/RV1/PROPOSED with objective and null plan. REVISE_SPEC clears applicable owner/readiness/subjects, increments generation, enters RESEARCHING; START_RESEARCH claims this unowned generation. Renew appends LeaseVersion. Test clock equality/restart, multi-process one-winner claims, stale tokens, idempotence and record immutability.

S2 — lifecycle.mjs. Implement every lifecycleContract table row as reduceLifecycle(snapshot,action) plus pure nextActions(snapshot); snapshot explicitly resolves current Work, records, dependency delivery and lease facts. CREATE/START_RESEARCH needs no branch/PR or delivered deps. PUBLISH_PLAN atomically increments generation and rotates Research ownership; readiness allSAT consumes owner, fresh implementation claim requires current readiness and all delivered deps. Stage candidate/evidence records in EXECUTING; REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT validates exact pair and reserves once. Candidate allSAT -> MERGE_PENDING, contradiction -> RESEARCHING/revoke, other failure -> BLOCKED without product scope. Merge receipt alone -> DELIVERED. Guards repeat in store; forbidden actions never become authority through next output. Cover every row, stale binding and negative blocker with actual apply and nextActions.

S3 — context-builder.mjs. Implement buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) returning goal, exact input refs/hashes, permitted outputs, readScope/writeScope/forbidden actions and Work-generation/Attempt bindings. Pure nextActions supplies legality; read-only phases have empty product write scope; research may output only current plan data, live execution only declared READY plan scope. No fs/clock/random/history/currentContextRef. Resolve immutable system facts before call. Test independently parsed/frozen snapshots return identical bytes, inputs unchanged, no files created and no fence requirement for reader operations.

S4 — server.mjs/cli.mjs/package.json. Install pinned controller outside source checkout. Exact CLI: bb serve --config ABS_SERVER_JSON; bb --config ABS_CLIENT_JSON create --objective ABS_JSON [--id V2-opaque]; bb --config ABS_CLIENT_JSON show|next|context WORK_ID; bb --config ABS_CLIENT_JSON apply WORK_ID --request ABS_ACTION_JSON. BB_CONTROL_CONFIG may supply client config when flag absent; never inspect cwd config/graph. Server JSON={url:loopback,authorityId,controllerDigest,database:absolute,tokenFile:absolute,systemFactsFile:absolute}; client JSON={url,authorityId,tokenFile:absolute,role}. Token files 0600 hold independent reader/actor/judge/operator capabilities; no token in output. On first serve initialize schema/authority metadata atomically, no Work/import; on reopen require matching identity/schema/controller. System facts are operator-pinned immutable registry/Living data, never local branch; create may use empty components/dependencies. create accepts objective body directly, store computes hash/control URI, allocates gen1/RV1/PROPOSED, returns id; apply START_RESEARCH claims it with no Git/PR. Bin bb and npm bb:v2 use import-safe createControlClient. show emits canonical Work only; wrong/unreachable authority fails, no fallback. Test actual CLI from two different Git worktrees and no-repo create/start; check legacy files/refs/status hashes unchanged, reject BB-n/import routes in isolated mode. No deployment or dual-write.

S5 — trust-adapter.mjs/test/blackboard-v2-control.test.mjs. Implement materializeWorkJudgment from canonical Work inline objective/plan and explicit immutable sources, preserving delivered typed question/negative-case policy and exact Work-generation/Attempt/version bindings. Invoke existing independent evaluate and validateEvaluation, never legacy loadSubject for new Work. Publish trusted exact Decision under CAS; stale trusted result is SUPERSEDED without Work effects, forged capability/answers reject. Verify delivery via delivered candidate/main/equal-tree/Living validators and exact accepted Decision. Tests include all N1-N6 literal titles, real exported symbols, every invariant observation, evaluator grammar fixtures, malformed/stale trust, receipt rejection and no legacy effects; npm run verify and declared Living state update. No production feature or genuine SATISFIED is inferred from scratch research models.

livingDocs.statement: Living system state records the delivered V2 Blackboard control-plane boundary, dedicated authority, executable lifecycle and pure context-builder semantics while legacy work remains uncutover.

selection.config: Explicit --config absolute external JSON, or BB_CONTROL_CONFIG absolute external path. Client URL+authorityId must match service metadata. No cwd discovery or URL-only authority override.
selection.database: server-owned absolute local-disk path, parent 0700/file0600; reject paths inside source checkout/.git/worktrees
selection.transport: HTTP 127.0.0.1; service rejects non-loopback bind unless separately installed trusted TLS; body max1MiB; request timeout30s; no network lookup from repository config
selection.authentication: out-of-checkout 0600 token file; capabilities reader/actor/judge/operator; compare opaque tokens safely; never emit secrets; distinct actor and independent judge identities

authorityContract.schema: metadata(authorityId,schemaVersion,controllerDigest,authorityMode,lastCommittedTime,allocationNextId); works(id PRIMARY KEY,resourceVersion,generation,specJson,statusJson,fenceCounter); attempts(id PRIMARY KEY,workId,generation,canonicalJson); records(id PRIMARY KEY,kind,workId,generation,hash,canonicalJson). Foreign keys and uniqueness enforce exact identities. All backing state is service authority, not Git.
authorityContract.transaction: BEGIN IMMEDIATE -> schema/auth/action validation -> sample trusted service Date.now -> CLOCK_REGRESSION check against durable lastCommittedTime -> compare expected resourceVersion/generation -> current lease/fence/subject checks -> records+Work+allocation update -> update lastCommittedTime -> COMMIT. Any exception ROLLBACK including allocation and inserted receipts. Busy timeout returns RETRYABLE_BUSY without effects. No unguarded file replace.
authorityContract.clock: Production clock cannot be supplied in request. Injectable test clock exists only at server construction in test harness. Positive safe-integer ttl range1000..3600000ms; lease expires at now>=leaseUntil. Renew requires same current owner/Attempt/fence and unexpired lease; takeover only after store time expiry. Process restart reopens same database, never resets lastCommittedTime/fenceCounter. Clock rollback blocks mutating operations; show remains readable.
api: POST /v2/works {id?:V2-opaque in isolated mode,spec} operator allocation/create; BB-n allowed only after cutover
authorityContract.result: canonical Work show contains no read timestamp/cwd/connection-local data. Quiescent reads have identical bytes. Error codes distinguish NOT_FOUND, WRONG_AUTHORITY, UNAUTHORIZED, CAS_CONFLICT, LEASE_HELD, STALE_FENCE, CLOCK_REGRESSION, PHASE_FORBIDDEN and RETRYABLE_BUSY. Mutations never accept full actor-authored Work replacement.

resourceContract.Work: Strict Work={id,resourceVersion,generation,spec,status}. id=V2-opaque in isolated mode, BB-n only after cutover; RV/generation positive integers. spec={objective:{ref,hash,body},plan:{ref,semanticHash,body}|null,dependencies:[{workId,requires,source:WORK|LIVING,binding?}],components:[id],writeScope:[path],forbiddenWrite:[path],labels?,provenance?}. status={phase,observedGeneration,activeAttemptRef|null,activeLeaseRef|null,candidateVersionRef|null,evidenceVersionRef|null,readinessDecisionRef|null,latestCandidateDecisionRef|null,deliveryReceiptRef|null,conditions:[{type,observedGeneration,subjectRef,subjectHash,reason}],dependencyFacts:[{workId,state,refs,hash}],leaseState:NONE|LIVE|EXPIRED,blockers:[code]}. refs are {kind,id,hash}. Sort/unique ids; store rejects cycles, unknown fields and invalid referenced bodies. Source branch never defines spec/status.
resourceContract.generation: Create generation1/RV1. Operator REVISE_SPEC changes semantic input, increments generation, revokes readiness/active Attempt, enters RESEARCHING, preserves fenceCounter. Fenced RESEARCH-role PUBLISH_PLAN is also a semantic change: validate exact objective/current predecessor, store new plan, increment generation, retire old Research Attempt and atomically allocate replacement Research Attempt bound to NEW generation/specHash with fenceCounter+1, same owner and store-clock lease; enter PLAN_JUDGMENT in that same transaction. Return the new token. Identical plan bytes are idempotent and do not increment generation/dispatch again. AllSAT readiness consumes Research ownership, clears activeAttemptRef and enters READY; CLAIM_EXECUTION creates a new IMPLEMENTATION Attempt only after readiness/dependency guards. Status/candidate/evidence changes increment RV only. Optional strict labels/provenance are operator metadata; candidate payload cannot change spec.
resourceContract.records: All Attempt, LeaseVersion, CandidateVersion, EvidenceVersion, Decision and DeliveryReceipt bodies are immutable. Attempt identity contains no mutable version-ref arrays. Renew appends a LeaseVersion and changes status.activeLeaseRef; candidate/evidence publication appends records and changes status version refs. Exact id+body retry is idempotent; differing body rejects. Old refs retain bytes; current status refs are store-owned. No Context record or graph projection is authoritative.
resourceContract.semanticHash: Spec hash/generation binds objective hash, plan semanticHash, dependencies, components and scopes. Labels/provenance are operator metadata: metadata-only update increments RV, not semantic generation or readiness/cache applicability. No title/revision counter can reset a failed semantic subject.

lifecycleContract.pureSignature: nextActions(snapshot) -> {actions:[{id,requiredInputs,preconditions}],blockers:[{code,refs}],forbidden:[actionId]}; snapshot includes exact Work id/generation/resourceVersion/spec/status and resolved immutable Decisions/record facts. Canonical ordering; no random ids, clock, I/O or hidden controller state. apply repeats table guards and transaction-owned fences/clock.
transitions: PROPOSED or RESEARCHING without a live owner + START_RESEARCH -> RESEARCHING: valid objective/components, expected RV/generation; allocate Research Attempt, persistent next fence and LeaseVersion. Research does not require source checkout/branch/PR or delivered dependencies.

RESEARCHING + PUBLISH_PLAN -> PLAN_JUDGMENT: live Research Attempt, exact objective-bound complete plan. Semantic change increments generation; retire old owner and atomically allocate replacement Research Attempt/fence/LeaseVersion for new generation, same owner. Return new token; byte-identical already-published plan has an idempotent result, no generation/dispatch repeat.

PLAN_JUDGMENT + PUBLISH_DECISION(kind=readiness): exact independently validated subject. All required SATISFIED -> READY and consume Research lease/Attempt; other outcomes -> RESEARCHING, preserving current Research ownership if live. Stale trusted subject -> SUPERSEDED record only, zero Work effects.

READY + CLAIM_EXECUTION -> EXECUTING: exact current readiness and all direct Work DELIVERED/external Living bindings valid. Allocate distinct Implementation Attempt/fence/LeaseVersion. Otherwise stay READY with dependency/readiness blockers.

EXECUTING or extension REPAIRING + PUBLISH_CANDIDATE/PUBLISH_EVIDENCE -> same phase: live owner, strict append-only version record and exact declared source scope. REQUEST_CANDIDATE_JUDGMENT -> JUDGING only both current version refs are exact, complete and bound to this Attempt/generation/spec; reserve exact subject/cacheKey once. No evidence hash from another candidate.

JUDGING + PUBLISH_DECISION(kind=candidate): validated allSAT -> MERGE_PENDING; PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION -> RESEARCHING, revoke readiness/ownership; remaining failures -> BLOCKED/SUPERVISION_REQUIRED. Base never grants REPAIRING. BB-157 replaces only this repairable-failure edge with LOOKBACK.

MERGE_PENDING + PUBLISH_DELIVERY_RECEIPT -> DELIVERED: exact independent accepted candidate Decision and trusted candidate/merge/main/tree/Living verification. Consume ownership. Invalid/missing receipt leaves MERGE_PENDING blocked; DELIVERED is terminal.

RENEW_LEASE preserves phase/generation/fence, appends live same-owner LeaseVersion. TAKE_OVER after store-clock expiry creates a new Attempt/fence/LeaseVersion, clears obsolete candidate/evidence applicability and exposes only actions legal in retained phase. A stranded judgment/repair requires controlled RESEARCHING recovery, never a manufactured new failed Decision.

REVISE_SPEC(operator) changes semantic input -> RESEARCHING, increments generation and RV, clears readiness/current subject/owner refs and preserves fenceCounter. START_RESEARCH then claims the new generation. RECONCILE(controller) updates only dependency/lease observations. BLOCKED is read-only; guarded operator REOPEN_RESEARCH clears obsolete subject authority and returns RESEARCHING. All actions recheck CAS/schema/auth/clock under BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
lifecycleContract.extension: Base declares status record refs and action dispatch extension seam. BB-157 adds LOOKBACK/PUBLISH_REFLECTION in lifecycle.mjs using supervision validation; no change to CAS/clock/fence implementation is needed. The core has no actor bypass around apply(action).
lifecycleContract.leaseReconciliation: Service controller observes expiry and direct dependency delivery into canonical status using a guarded store transaction. It uses store time and no actor fence because it owns control observation, not Attempt outputs. Spec/generation never change. Before reconciliation an action may be blocked; mutation guards always reject expired tokens independently.

contextContract.signature: buildContext(snapshot,systemFacts) -> {goal,inputs,readScope,writeScope,forbidden,requiredOutput,bindings}; snapshot includes Work id/generation/RV/spec/status plus resolved immutable records/Decisions. Caller resolves Living/component/source facts beforehand; builder never reads disk, scans directories, mutates store or persists output.
contextContract.routing: PROPOSED/RESEARCHING uses current objective/current plan only and output READY_IMPLEMENT_PLAN; writes only research plan. PLAN_JUDGMENT/JUDGING/MERGE_PENDING/BLOCKED has empty product writeScope and exact judgment/evidence/merge inputs. EXECUTING/REPAIRING yields exact plan scope only when current readiness, dependencies and live Attempt status facts hold; server rechecks live fence on effects. DELIVERED has only Living truth and no writable action.
contextContract.binding: Output includes exact Work spec/generation, resolved record hashes and system-fact hashes as evidence binding, not a Context identity/generation. It contains no createdAt, parent context, currentContextRef or history chain. Repeated builds on immutable inputs are byte-equivalent.

trustContract.Attempt: Attempt={id,workId,workGeneration,specHash,kind:RESEARCH|IMPLEMENTATION,owner,fence,issuedAt,baseSha?,sourceRef?,worktree?}, immutable after claim. LeaseVersion={id,attemptRef,owner,fence,issuedAt,leaseUntil}, immutable; RENEW_LEASE inserts a new version for the same Attempt/fence only while its current lease is live. CandidateVersion/EvidenceVersion each bind attemptRef,Work generation,specHash and exact source/evidence hashes; they are separate immutable bodies referenced from status. Source identity is input data and never authority.
trustContract.Decision: {id,workId,observedGeneration,specHash,attemptRef,subject:{objectiveHash,planHash,candidateSha?,candidateTree?,evidenceSetHash?},jev:{model,policy,stateHash,specHash,cacheKey,answers,evaluationRef/evaluationHash},storeSequence,publication:APPLIED|SUPERSEDED}. Sequence assigned inside store transaction, not actor timestamp. Independent trusted adapter validates all required answers and evaluation bindings; model/policy and outcomes stay delivered existing policy.
trustContract.publication: Check exact Work generation+spec hash+current Attempt identity/fence+exact current candidate/evidence and phase under CAS. Stale but structurally valid trusted Decision is immutable SUPERSEDED and never changes Work status/phase/conditions. Wrong capability or forged/malformed receipts reject rather than retaining purported correctness. Concurrent spec edit vs Decision application serializes into one winner; loser cannot resurrect readiness.
trustContract.DeliveryReceipt: Existing trusted verifyDelivery-equivalent checks execute in pinned controller adapter over exact immutable source objects: candidate ancestor of actual merge; merge ancestor of observed main; evaluated candidate tree==merge tree; declared required source/Living blobs unchanged; trusted all-SATISFIED candidate Decision binds same Work/Attempt. Receipt has candidateSha,candidateTree,mergeSha,observedMainSha,planHash,evidenceHash,decisionRef,consolidatedRefs. Missing Git object or invalid bound evidence is blocker, never inferred PASS.
trustContract.adapters: trust-adapter.mjs exports materializeWorkJudgment({work,attempt,kind,sourceSnapshot,evidence,policy}) -> existing materialized envelope {lane,subject,payload,stateHash,specHash,cacheKey,livingChanges?,candidateChanges?,changeSet?}. Input objective/plan bodies come from Work.spec, sources from explicit immutable Git snapshot, never client cwd or legacy loadSubject. It builds the delivered RESEARCH_SA/WORKER question/criteria grammar and state schema, adds exact {workId,generation,specHash,attemptRef,subjectVersionRefs} binding as semantic data, and uses existing canonical/hash, model/policy/outcomes, evaluate and validateEvaluation(evaluation,expected). Phase,RV,renewal time and reservation status do not enter semantic cacheKey; CAS/fence separately recheck publication. No legacy graph registration or synthetic renamed Work id. Worker fixtures compare question grammar/negative bindings with delivered materializer fixtures, invoke trusted validators on valid/malformed/stale evaluations and test provider reservation. Large worker subjects retain delivered bounded batching/budget, no altered verdict rules.
trustContract.limits: Prototype synthetic Decisions test binding/control safety only; no new real SATISFIED result is claimed by this plan. Trusted receipts, real Jev and exact merge verification remain required in Worker evidence.

coexistenceContract.mode: ISOLATED_NEW_WORK service initializes empty works table with no legacy graph reader/import API. Accept only newly allocated V2-opaque ids; reject BB-n create/claim/import before any effects. Legacy current work remains solely legacy; no mirrored row or dual-write. BB-156 later atomically imports and switches allocator to BB-n above all ids; existing isolated V2 ids remain unique.
coexistenceContract.deliveryBoundary: BB-155 Worker tests a separate ISOLATED_NEW_WORK service and new V2 ids only; no import/cutover action is registered in that release. BB-156 owns the migration-only module/selector transaction and external freeze. Combined research reproduction has separately named scratch migration tests for BB-156, not a BB-155 product migration. BB-157 owns LOOKBACK/reflection policy. Delivered API divergence reopens research.

researchSummary.run: 33 combined research controls passed/0failed/0skip. BB-155 authority/lease/context/bootstrap controls create only fresh scratch Work; separately labelled BB-156 tests import a historical snapshot into separate owned scratch databases and do not touch live authority.
controls: Shared authority exact CLI bytes across2Git worktrees; bootstrap before branch
researchSummary.limits: Scratch model deliberately exercises selected risks. It omits production auth, full strict schemas, trust-adapter provider dispatch and real receipt verification. Required future product tests invoke actual planned exports; no real control authority, current task migration or delivery was performed.
researchSummary.replayRef: researchReproduction embeds exact hash-bound sources/tests/output as data; no authority receipt.

objectiveCoverage.objectiveCriterion: From two different source checkouts/worktrees, `bb show <WORK_ID>` resolves byte-equivalent authoritative Work state from one control-plane authority.
A brand-new work item can be created and enter research without first merging a source-code registration PR.
The V2 Work resource separates desired semantic state from observed lifecycle state and provides an explicit revision/generation binding for stale judgment detection.
`bb next <WORK_ID>` derives the bounded legal next actions and blockers from executable lifecycle state without requiring jev.md or previous conversation.
`buildContext(<WORK_ID>)` derives the current agent goal, inputs, read/write authority, forbidden actions and required output without persisting a context artifact.
Source branch/worktree/candidate identity is recorded only as an Attempt bound to a Work and cannot redefine the Work objective/plan or lifecycle authority.
V2 can run against empty/new Work resources in parallel with the legacy Blackboard, with no migration or dual-write of current legacy tasks in this task.

researchReproduction.extract: Decode each gzipBase64 into named files under an owned scratch directory. Set V2_RESEARCH_SOURCE_ROOT to a Git repository containing exact d795bca0e1865685d6b11b66de12224691446897 objects; execute node --test probe.test.mjs. Legacy graph and routing source are read with git show at that immutable SHA, not from current checkout. All service databases/config/Git worktrees are owned scratch and disposed.

bootstrapContract.create: create accepts objective JSON body, not an existing source ref. The store validates OBJECTIVE fields, hashes body and assigns bb://authorityId/works/id/objective; published plans similarly use store-owned URI+semanticHash+inline body. No required local artifact or registration path. Empty components/dependencies are valid; named components resolve operator-pinned registry in service system facts. Atomic id allocation+Work insertion gen1/RV1/PROPOSED; duplicates/cycles/invalid bodies roll back. Source identity appears only in later Attempt.
